title: What is liberation for women today?
text: and I mistake Jessica and what is it all about we're asking a number of prominent spiritual teachers and other other women a single question which is what is liberation for women today well you know it's not so much what liberation is a woman it's what woman do with liberation and rachou ality and the path that has opened to them in the 21st century I think the liberation for women today is to give birth to the authentic feminine self for the first time and perhaps thousands of years and to express that self through life purpose in action in the world although I began as an adversarial activists being against what i considered in those days in the 60s being against oppression against inequality etc etc my sense of where our power lies is now in standing for and standing width and standing on behalf of the things we most deeply care about in terms of our common future so we're working all the time to liberate these patterns that are holding us back from being able to move forward in a way where we're happy in relationship to the masculine we can challenge the mask and we can ignore the masculine but we're not in reaction to the masculine you know the first thing that came to mind when I read the question is what women and what life conditions and you know coming from an Arab country I was born and raised in Lebanon and living adopting the West now as my home country I can see different levels of liberation because women are going through different levels of liberation that are equally important for each culture for me liberation has something to do with the nature of one's holistic well-being and you could have that holistic well-being in poverty and you could have that whole list aquo being in slavery and other people would see that as a contradiction but there there are at the present still filets and there were people especially in my ancestry who were slaves who nevertheless believe in their right to be free from slavery but were within themselves still capable of not being enslaved I think what I've come to realize at this point in my life is that life is utterly insecure and that that's the good news like it isn't bad news for me anymore I think that I was younger I didn't want to face the nature of life I I wanted to believe I was immortal I want to believe there were something coming to rescue me there was someone coming to protect me I'm not avoiding those things anymore I'm not denying those things anymore i'm not spending my energy pretending those things aren't true and i'm not going to people in relationships to fix me or cuddle me or rescue me or take care of me or I there's a there's a mutuality and relationships there's respect there's a separateness in my own being where I meet another person separately and I think that really if I look at my life has been the deepest liberation what is liberation for women today i feel it's linked around a very distinct desire and many many women to know themselves more foley and and to realize themselves as consciousness i see that women secular liberation is deeply related to spiritual liberation of women nowadays and is all this seems to me to be many crossovers between women's liberation and the path of enlightenment in one form or another it's a fantastic time to be a woman actually and that we should take that opportunity and use it to the best of our abilities and not wait this human lifetime because now we have everything really no we are educated we are socially much more free we are able to think for ourselves outside the usual paradigms we essentially can do whatever we want with this life now so we shouldn't wait it you
